title: Senior Microbiology Scientist, Qpex BioPharma, wholly-owned subsidiary of Shionogi Inc. in San Diego, CA

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Microbiology Scientist to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities
Assist in the design, planning, and execution of experiments to investigate and optimize antibiotic compounds.
Utilize advanced molecular genetics techniques to analyze mechanisms of action for potential antibiotic candidates.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including medicinal chemists, microbiologists, and pharmacologists, to contribute to the overall drug discovery process.
Stay abreast of current literature and emerging trends in antibiotic development to inform and enhance research strategies.
Contribute to the preparation and submission of regulatory documents as required for drug development programs.
Maintain accurate and detailed laboratory records, ensuring compliance with industry standards and protocols.
Contribute to the publication of research findings in scientific journals and presentations at conferences.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This role will eventually have direct reports.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in Microbiology, Molecular Biology or a related field.
Demonstrated expertise in molecular genetics.
Minimum 2 years' experience in microbiology and molecular genetics research, with a proven track record of scientific contributions in the field.
Expertise in a range of molecular genetics techniques, including gene disruption, gene expression, sequence analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data sets.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of drug discovery processes, including assay development and high-throughput screening.
Ability to travel (approximately 10%).
To be considered for this position, you must apply and meet the requirements of this opportunity.
